newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina March crude output 4.07 mln m3 -industry.
newsitem.headline: Argentina March crude output 4.07 mln m3 -industry.

text.p: Argentine oil operators produced 4.07 million cubic meters of crude in March, or an average 131,360 cubic meters a day, the Argentine Petroleum and Gas Institute said Tuesday.

This compared with production of 3.67 million cubic meters, or 131,068 cubic meters a day in February, and 4.02 million cubic meters in January, or 128,643 cubic meters a day, the industry group said.

Argentine natural gas output totaled 2,999 billion cubic meters in March, or 96.7 billion cubic meters a day, and 2,754 billion cubic meters in February, or 98.4 billion cubic meters a day. Natural gas output was 2,974 billion cubic meters in January, or 95.9 billion cubic meters a day.
